name: Stolen Vitality — +3/+1 always, first strike when it is not your turn
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py ('otherwise' / 'if kicked … instead' theme). 'Target creature gets +3/+1 until end of turn. If it's your turn, that creature gains trample until end of turn. Otherwise, it gains first strike until end of turn.' The mid-line 'If it's your turn' gated the whole line (no +3/+1 off-turn), trample was a global effect, and the Otherwise sentence was ignored. Both branches now sit on their own lines, with the spell's target as subject and sharing its target slot.
